common.Control.new: needs project management: the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`) and has no verb to create a new project or document, so there is nothing for New to start
common.Control.open: needs project management: the studio serves one project directory chosen at launch and has no verb to open or switch to another project
common.Control.toggleGridOverrides: needs per-item-type grid overrides (the Edit Grids dialog's connected-items / wires / vias / text / graphics grids and category-aware snapping in the move, drag and route tools); the studio snaps every item to the one grid, so the toggle would switch off nothing. (Ctrl+Shift+G stays bound to Ungroup here; KiCad binds it to this action and leaves Ungroup unbound)
common.Interactive.pasteSpecial: nothing to special-case yet: its options are annotation handling for pasted footprints/symbols and clearing the nets of pasted copper, but the studio's clipboard holds no footprints or symbols (only tracks, vias, zones, shapes and text), every copper item must name a net, and the schematic has no copy/paste at all
pcbnew.Generator.genCacnelEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to cancel
pcbnew.Generator.genFinishEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to finish
pcbnew.Generator.genRemove: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to remove
pcbnew.Generator.genStartEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to start editing
pcbnew.Generator.genUpdateEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to update
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAll: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAllTuning: needs tuning-pattern generator items (PCB_TUNING_PATTERN); the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks and keeps no pattern to re-tune within its bounds
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateSelected: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.showManager: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so the Generators Manager would have nothing to list
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.applyDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so no group can be linked to a block layout
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.barcode: needs barcode items (PCB_BARCODE: a barcode or QR code generated from text); the design IR has no barcode item or encoder and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.ddImportGraphi: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer (this is Import Graphics reached by dropping a file on the canvas); none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeCharacter: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board characteristics as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeImportedG: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedDes: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to link to a group or place
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placePoint: needs point items (PCB_POINT: reference/snap points stored on the board); the design IR has no point item and the snapping code knows no such anchor
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeReference: needs reference-image items (PCB_REFERENCE_IMAGE: a bitmap on a graphic layer, kept out of every output); the design IR has no image item
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeStackup: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board stackup as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinkedDe: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to save a group to
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.textbox: needs text-box items (PCB_TEXTBOX: wrapped text in a bordered box); the design IR's Text is plain text with no box, border or wrapping
pcbnew.PadTool.explodePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.PadTool.recombinePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.TableEditor.editTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
eeschema.EditorControl.importGraphics: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignB: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.autoplaceFields: needs per-instance symbol field positions (the schematic IR stores no field placement: reference and value are drawn at fixed offsets, so there is nothing to autoplace) and text metrics for the placement search
eeschema.Simulation.newAnalysisTab: needs ngspice; kicad-cli has no simulator
